vc.fill_alone.source: cycles before the first word, cycles a 32-byte word: a vector core's fills of 2 KB and 256 B alone, Verilated card_v9t3_1n; no v9t6 figure yet (RUL.064)

vc.fill_shared.source: the same fills beside a four-cluster matmul, Verilated card_v9t3_1n; no v9t6 figure yet (RUL.064)

vc.launch_gap.source: idle cycles a launch adds: TG.RUN.015's read as one launch (idle 2346) and as two (idle 3995), Verilated card_v9t6_1n

vc.launch_front.source: cycles a run spends outside its steps: head, copy, bind and barrier, 1707-2310 over nine kernels of 2 to 62 KB, Verilated card_v9t6_1n

vc.send_cycles.source: node cycles a vector send beyond its words: the timed model's fit to anchor send_two (software/tests/perf/anchors/node.ktpu), Verilated card_v9t6_1n

vc.word_cycles.source: node cycles a unit word sent or a step loaded: the timed model's fit to anchors send_two and send_words, Verilated card_v9t6_1n

vc.image_word_cycles.source: node cycles a program word sent to its core, once a launch: the timed model's fit to anchors long_64, long_256 and again_256, Verilated card_v9t6_1n

vc.wait_cycles.source: node cycles a wait on a unit, once the unit is done: the timed model's fit to anchors wait_8 and wait_32, Verilated card_v9t6_1n

mg.shared_b_max.source: largest shared B fill the follower receives right, Verilated build/v9f card, 2026-10-12 (96 and 128 entries wrong)

mover.copy_cost.source: cycles a contiguous run, cycles a 32-byte word: four move-only kernels of 15000 to 39200 words at runs of 1 to 28 words, each within 2 %, Verilated card_v9t6_1n

mover.move_cycles.source: node cycles a move statement before its first command: the timed model's fit to anchors copy_64 and copy_1024, Verilated card_v9t6_1n

mover.statement_cycles.source: mover cycles between two copies of a move: the timed model's fit to anchors ops_12 and ops_48, Verilated card_v9t6_1n

mover.fill_cycles.source: mover cycles between two fills of a move: the timed model's fit to anchor fills_12, Verilated card_v9t6_1n

mover.element_cycles.source: mover cycles an indexed element of a gather or scatter beyond its words: the timed model's fit to anchors gather_1024 and scatter_1024, Verilated card_v9t6_1n
